about: Argus's built-in Presets (GLOSSARY: Preset). Original values, written for Argus after studying how Lightroom groups its presets and what classic film stocks and film looks do; no preset file was copied. Numbers are added to the Photo's Recipe at Amount 100 (keys in `absolute` are set instead), so a Preset stacks on Auto. Schema: engine/src/presets.rs.

presets.name: Natural
presets.why: A light, honest lift: softer highlights, open shadows, a touch of colour.

presets.name: Bright and airy
presets.why: Brighter and softer, warm skin, quieter greens. For daylight people and interiors.

presets.name: Cool and clean
presets.why: Neutral to slightly cool with crisp whites. For architecture, snow and product shots.

presets.name: Vivid
presets.why: Richer colour and punch without crunchy skin.

presets.name: Moody
presets.why: Darker and quieter, muted greens and blues, cool shadows.

presets.name: Crisp
presets.why: More texture and local contrast, a little haze cut. Detail without a colour change.

presets.name: Soft portrait
presets.why: Gentle contrast, glowing skin, softer texture. Flattering in most light.

presets.name: Golden skin
presets.why: Warm, sunlit skin with golden highlights.

presets.name: Clean studio
presets.why: Clear, even and true skin, bright whites, sharper eyes.

presets.name: Editorial matte
presets.why: Matte blacks, muted colour that keeps skin warm, teal shadows. Magazine feel.

presets.name: Clear day
presets.why: Cuts haze, holds the sky, deepens blue and adds detail.

presets.name: Lush greens
presets.why: Fresh, slightly cooler greens and richer foliage.

presets.name: Golden hour
presets.why: Warm low sun: golden highlights, amber shadows, soft contrast.

presets.name: Soft mist
presets.why: Airy and quiet: lower contrast, a little haze, cool and pale.

presets.name: Warm film
presets.why: Everyday colour negative: warm, lifted blacks, soft highlights, fine grain.

presets.name: Portrait 400
presets.why: After classic portrait negative film: warm skin, muted greens, gentle highlight roll-off, warm-blue shadows.

presets.name: Pastel 400
presets.why: After overexposed pastel wedding film: bright, minty greens, soft blues, cool shadows.

presets.name: Vivid 100
presets.why: After fine-grain saturated slide-like negative film: strong reds and blues, deep blacks.

presets.name: Chrome
presets.why: Documentary slide film feel: muted colour, deep shadows, cyan-leaning blues, neutral highlights.

presets.name: Faded negative
presets.why: Nostalgic print look: hard highlights, lifted blacks, teal shadows, muted yellows, warm reds.

presets.name: Tungsten 800
presets.why: After tungsten-balanced cinema film at night: cool, glowing reds and ambers, grain.

presets.name: Teal and orange
presets.why: The blockbuster split: warm skin against teal shadows and cool backgrounds, kept subtle.

presets.name: Bleach bypass
presets.why: Silvery, low-colour, high-contrast war-film look.

presets.name: Blue hour
presets.why: Cool, deep and quiet; dusk and city lights.

presets.name: Golden cinema
presets.why: Warm, sun-baked feature-film grade with quieted blues.

presets.name: Indie fade
presets.why: Pastel yellows, faded blacks and soft greens; storybook indie film.

presets.name: Seventies
presets.why: Warm, faded print with olive greens and pale blues.

presets.name: Instant
presets.why: Instant-print look: bright, low contrast, creamy highlights, cyan shadows, soft corners.

presets.name: Faded
presets.why: Washed blacks and quiet colour, like an old album print.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.why: Brown-toned monochrome with soft blacks and grain.

presets.name: B&W soft
presets.why: Gentle monochrome with open shadows and bright skin.

presets.name: B&W contrast
presets.why: Punchy monochrome with deep blacks and bright whites.

presets.name: Grainy film
presets.why: After classic 400-speed black-and-white film: an S-curve and gritty grain.

presets.name: Dark skies
presets.why: Like a red filter: dark dramatic skies, bright skin and stone.

presets.name: High key
presets.why: Bright, airy monochrome with little shadow.

presets.name: Warm tone
presets.why: Monochrome with a faint warm paper tone.

presets.name: Noir
presets.why: Hard, dark and dramatic, with heavy corners.

presets.name: Spring
presets.why: Fresh light greens and blossom pinks, bright and soft.

presets.name: Summer
presets.why: Warm sun, blue water and sky, a bit more punch.

presets.name: Autumn
presets.why: Rich oranges and reds, greens turned toward gold.

presets.name: Winter
presets.why: Cold clean whites, crisp detail and blue shadows.

presets.name: Urban grit
presets.why: Gritty street look: hard detail, muted colour that keeps skin, cool tone.

presets.name: City night
presets.why: Night streets: held highlights, open shadows, cleaner noise, richer neon.

presets.name: Food
presets.why: Appetising: warm, bright, rich reds and greens, crisp texture.

presets.name: Brighten faces
presets.why: Finds every face and lifts it a little.

presets.name: Smooth skin
presets.why: Natural skin smoothing that keeps pores.

presets.name: Eyes and teeth
presets.why: Brighter eyes and whiter teeth, found by the face detector.

presets.name: Polish
presets.why: The light retouch: faces a touch brighter, skin evened, eyes and teeth lifted.

presets.name: Define hair
presets.why: More texture and shine in hair.

presets.name: Blue drama
presets.why: Darker, bluer sky with more depth.

presets.name: Golden sky
presets.why: Warm sunset colour in the sky only.

presets.name: Recover sky
presets.why: Brings back a bright sky's detail without changing its colour.

presets.name: Storm
presets.why: Heavy, dark and textured clouds.

presets.name: Pop
presets.why: Makes the main subject stand out a little.

presets.name: Light
presets.why: Lifts the light on the subject.

presets.name: Darken background
presets.why: Quietens the background so the subject reads first.

presets.name: Spotlight
presets.why: Subject a little brighter, background darker and calmer, soft corners.
